en.title: The Most Delicious Boat Ever
en.content: What happens when you combine summer fun with creative thinking? You get a watermelon boat! Neale's colorful drawing shows the most amazing vessel ever - a bright green watermelon carved into a perfect boat shape, complete with red juicy flesh inside. This isn't just any ordinary boat; it's a snack and transportation all in one! The vibrant green rind forms the hull, while the sweet red interior provides comfortable seating for tiny passengers. Neale imagines sailing across a blue summer lake in this fruity vessel, and when you get hungry during the voyage, you can simply take a bite of your boat! The black seeds scattered throughout could serve as tiny anchors, and the refreshing watermelon juice would keep everyone cool on hot summer days.

zh.title: 史上最美味的船
zh.content: 当你把夏日乐趣与创意思维结合起来会发生什么？你会得到一艘西瓜船！恩恩的彩色画作展示了最神奇的船只——一个明亮的绿色西瓜被雕刻成完美的船形，里面有红色多汁的果肉。这不是普通的船；它是零食和交通工具的完美结合！鲜艳的绿色瓜皮形成船体，而甜美的红色内部为小乘客提供舒适的座位。恩恩想象着在这艘水果船上航行在蓝色的夏日湖泊上，当你在航行中饿了的时候，你可以简单地咬一口你的船！散布在各处的黑色种子可以作为小锚，清爽的西瓜汁会让每个人在炎热的夏日保持凉爽。
